column4: UF splenic HSA vaccine same postoperative clinical study; exact intervention, site and disease.
Biopsy/sample comparison of acquired toceranib resistance; does not assign an anticancer intervention in this study.
Perioperative thrombosis outcomes in patients undergoing their standard tumour surgery.

CSU FAP engineered T cells plus oral immunotherapy, exact soft-tissue sarcoma study; registry title mentions osteosarcoma historically, current site text and diagnosis support soft-tissue sarcoma, no second eligible cohort from title.

Published VCT25005915 names PD-1 and targeted immunotherapy for metastatic cancer, but Veterinary Oncology Services route did not establish current protocol-specific clinic allocation or financial terms.

Current registry relates to named MYC-inhibition tolerability protocol with same CASE and partners. Existing nonmatchable investigational tolerance record; registry status alone is not a reason to promote.
Fatty mass cryoablation lead does not establish malignant oncology cohort.

Exact Paul Hess Raleigh intravesical immunotherapy for muscle-invasive UCC, same at-least-8-kg and washouts. NCSU still gives explicit 2026-09-30 cutoff. AVMA 2028 is study end; keep matching disabled.

VCT26005971, Sara Allstadt, VSNT Fort Worth. Registry suggests doxorubicin/temozolomide with or without propranolol but prior-chemotherapy rules refer to a carboplatin alternative. Distinct VCT, site and date from Dallas VCT25005913; no merged or new matchable arm from this ambiguity.
UMN autologous tumour lysate plus Zika-virus vaccine protocol for high-grade glioma; same institution, mechanism and disease.
Michigan State quasiorganelle therapy for confirmed canine histiocytic sarcoma, exact named intervention and investigation site.
Registry Davis VCCT FAP CAR-T sarcoma arm, same site, 11 kg, CAR-T after Cytoxan and end May 31 as current Davis arm of this canonical multicentre record. Date does not govern Tufts.
Older multicentre ECT record does not enumerate hospitals in primary and organizer link is not readable; no current study-specific site availability established.
Older ECT with canine IL-12 gene transfer registry lead; institution/site roster not established by its current official links; not a generic directory entry.
Guelph OVC porphysome nanoparticle/photoactivation treatment for oral SCC in cats, matches exact unit and treatment.
UF appendicular OSA vaccine, exact study distinct from the designed mRNA vaccine programme.
Colorado State dual-energy CT bone mineral density while receiving SBRT; research intervention is imaging, not assigned anticancer enrolment.
Ohio State mammary-tumour imaging. Not the separate MSU investigational metastatic mammary chemotherapy protocol.
VCT24005858 older oncology-services bone ECT, distinct registry ID from newer VCT26005963, current treating facility and relation to exact cementoplasty cohort need confirmation.
CSU single radiation for confirmed canine TVT, ≥1 cm assessable lesion and exact protocol source/clinic.
UMN anti-tumour nanoparticle gene-delivery study in high-grade glioma, same exact intervention and cohort; institutional route restricted.
Exact PRISM radiation + molecular follow-up canines, UC Davis and August 2031 date.

NC State enhanced ethanol for feline mandibular/maxillary SCC. Own registry primary end June 30, 2020 and no current NCSU invitation or dated extension; reject recruiting label as historical stale per cutoff.
Same Ethos-PUSH umbrella HSA identity. Broad registry historical site list does not establish every site is currently active; retain exact site question.
MIMIC minimally invasive pulmonary metastasectomy, same cohort and clinical teams; precise individual site/owner terms still open.
UF vaccine melanoma cohort; current UF clinic index shows matching invitation.
MSU anti-cancer therapeutic for metastatic feline mammary carcinoma, distinct from OSU imaging.
CSU CAR-T plus verdinexor for canine glioma; same intervention, specialty and 2028 registry study end.
VCT24005857 nasal ECT; exact registry treatment body available but no currently named treating hospital in published roster; criteria include an ambiguous survival exclusion wording.
Penn PSMA ligand prostate theranostic, same treatment and institution; do not infer unprinted clinical costs.
Official registry links the exact Flint Cancer Center bladder TCC lapatinib with fractionated radiation protocol.
Ohio State microscopic sarcoma extension analysis with histology, not a new assigned anticancer study.
Canine AGASACA sentinel-node mapping. Primary objective route identification/staging; no distinct assigned anticancer treatment demonstrated.
CSU 3D printed bioreplaceable implant, giant dog distal radius stage II OSA, and exact Flint protocol link; not the UF fracture-prevention or VOS ECT technique.
UW 90Y-NM600 targeted radiopharmaceutical for canine PTCL; current primary status/funding full reread remains limited.
CSU AML trametinib, same lab confirmation, dose-study context and treating oncology team. AVMA 2027-12-31 vs CSU 2028-03-31 remains a date conflict, no automatic overwrite.

New treatment candidate VCT26005963 explicitly evaluates targeted bone ECT plus cementoplasty for canine appendicular OSA. Registry names New York, Boca Raton and Anchorage but no specific treating clinics, schedule/intake or owner charge. Distinct from supportive UF SBRT plus cementoplasty and French BIOCERA-VET.
OVC blood test for early OSA relapse detection; diagnostic monitoring.
CSU study-specific goal is near-infrared ICG detection and margin mapping during planned treatment surgery. No independently assigned anticancer intervention beyond routine surgery established.
Exact CAre canine glioma radiation plus autophagy inhibition at UC Davis; primary 2028-01-04 and registry January 3 differ, retain explicit discrepancy.
Older Veterinary Oncology Services nasal ECT VCT18004664 lists study end November 1, 2024; no extension found; distinct VCT from 2024-initiated nasal ECT listing.
Single-dose plasma pharmacokinetic analysis of anti-cancer agents; research PK sampling, not an anticancer treatment course.
Michigan State randomized first-line CHOP vs LOPP for naïve canine peripheral T-cell lymphoma, exact intervention and site.
